existing_alternatives: The road controller read _settings_game.vehicle.road_side and _settings_game.pf.roadveh_queue through OpenTTDRoadEntry, a per-call record the C++ facade filled with RustRoadSide() and RustRoadQueue(); that record is a snapshot carrier the pass deletes. reason: #964 decision 4: RoadVehLeaveDepot, IndividualRoadVehicleController and RoadFindPathToDest read these two settings at their observation points with one field-sized load each. Two catalog fields against the deleted OpenTTDRoadEntry record (5 fields), GetRoadEntry and RustRoadQueue.
retirement_condition: The fields leave the catalog when Rust owns the game settings storage.
